newsitem.title: CHINA: Cathay eases ahead of interim results.
newsitem.headline: Cathay eases ahead of interim results.

text.p: Shares of Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd eased on expectation of a disappointing earnings ahead of the release of its interim results due later on Wednesday, brokers said.
"Expectation that the airlines may report a disapppointing interims triggered selling," said Anthony Mak, sales director at Vickers Ballas Securities.
The company shares fell HK$0.30 to HK$13.90 by late morning on volume of 4.53 million shares.
Analysts said Cathay Pacific had a difficult first half of 1997 and a decline in Japanese traffic could hit its earnings.
